title: sysmlc: compiling SysML v2 models into digital logic (code and data)
description: Compiler from a SysML v2 textual subset to SMT formulas and Verilog, with the models, scripts, baseline runs and reference results of the article 'Systems Models as Logic Circuits: Compiling SysML v2 Requirements, Behavior, Variability and Allocation Into Digital Logic' (IEEE Access, submitted).
